mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 6.4% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns do not turn negative within 5 days when UNRATE crosses above 6.4% with a 0.3pp increase in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) by over 5% in three months signals a robust economic expansion, driving investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and INDPRO rises >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline when both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed 5% growth in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high GDP demand (GDPC1) and low unemployment (UNRATE) create sustained investor optimism, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns underperform historical late-cycle expansion benchmarks despite high GDPC1 and low UNRATE values.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST demand metrics exceeding 10 units in a single month indicates accelerated economic activity, triggering short-term market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite HOUST exceeding 10 units in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate remains persistently low (<1%) while the CPIAUCSL inflation index rises sharply (>1% in two months), investors anticipate prolonged inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <1% and CPIAUCSL rises >1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to turn negative when FEDFUNDS stays below 1% and CPIAUCSL increases by over 1% in two months.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated labor demand metrics (PAYEMS) above historical averages signal strong job market conditions, fostering corporate growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not rise significantly above baseline when PAYEMS exceeds historical averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, rising demand metrics (RSAFS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicate economic normalization, driving investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns underperform recovery benchmarks when RSAFS rises and UNRATE falls in the post-shock regime.
